Card Q&A.a: No, the effect doesn’t activate for Digimon in breeding areas.
Card Q&A.q: This Digimon is in my breeding area. If I digivolve it into a Digimon card with [Myotismon] in its name in my hand, is the memory cost of the digivolution reduced by 1?

Effect: [Your Turn] When this Digimon digivolves into a Digimon card with [Myotismon] in its name in your hand, reduce the memory cost of the digivolution by 1.
Inherited Effect: [Your Turn] While this Digimon has [Myotismon] in its name, all of your Digimon with ＜Retaliation＞ can attack your opponent's unsuspended level 4 or lower Digimon.
